note: Every runtime dependency of the pinned NewPipeExtractor, recursively, from its published POM/Gradle metadata (checked by .github/workflows/youtube-dependency.yml). nanojson, jsoup, jsr305, protobuf-javalite, rhino and rhino-engine declare no further runtime dependencies.

components.title: NewPipeExtractor
components.note: Combined into Meditejo under AGPL-3.0 (GPLv3 section 13). The extractor's licence does not grant a licence to any YouTube recording.

components.title: nanojson (TeamNewPipe fork)
components.note: Upstream: https://github.com/mmastrac/nanojson. The fork carries no LICENSE file; the licence is stated in each source file header and the upstream README says it is dual-licensed under the MIT and Apache licences. Meditejo uses it under Apache-2.0.

components.title: JSR-305 annotations
components.note: The Maven POM labels this artifact Apache-2.0; the upstream reference-implementation LICENSE (https://github.com/amaembo/jsr-305/blob/d9f2803f994ea35e2f64e9fbb9a0ea5e2e16c418/ri/LICENSE) is the BSD-3-Clause text shown here.

components.title: Rhino and rhino-engine
components.note: MPL-2.0 Source Code Form: Meditejo ships Rhino 1.8.1 unmodified. Its source is available from https://github.com/mozilla/rhino/tree/Rhino1_8_1_Release and https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/org/mozilla/rhino/1.8.1/rhino-1.8.1-sources.jar (rhino-engine: https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/org/mozilla/rhino-engine/1.8.1/rhino-engine-1.8.1-sources.jar). Rhino's own NOTICE, covering the V8 and Raffaello Giulietti portions, follows the licence text.
